title: Agent Runtime Preflight Engineering
objective: Produce the final runtime-neutral engineering specification for NEXUS QUANT agents so P02-F can begin implementation without redesign, while preserving all roadmap, security, risk and financial authority gates.
constraints: This task is Agent Layer only and must not execute P01-F or any other main-roadmap workstream
P02-F is not active; production runtime implementation remains forbidden
No production agent framework may be selected or installed
No runtime dependency may be pinned as a production decision
No credentials, accounts, funding, broker/exchange connectivity or financial authority
A5 and A8 vetoes remain deterministic and non-bypassable
Live Trading and Auto Trading remain disabled
tests: A0-A10 runtime adapter spec preserves canonical authority
Specialist lifecycle forbids recursive unbounded spawning and authority escalation
A5/A8 veto gates are deterministic and non-bypassable
Message validation fails closed on schema/provenance/freshness failures
Security spec treats external content as untrusted data
Observability/evaluation spec covers trace, cost, token, latency, retries and red-team cases
security_tests: No hidden memory as authority or evidence
No specialist can bypass parent/Task Contract authority
No Live Trading or Auto Trading activation
Safe failure states include WAIT, NO_TRADE and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
rollback: Revert FIN-P01-WG-003 documentation-only commits. No runtime, dependency, secret, account, deployment or financial state is changed.
definition_of_ready: No active conflicting Agent Layer writer
definition_of_done: Runtime security and tool-abuse controls complete
Observability and evaluation harness specification complete
P02-F implementation sequence and framework decision gate complete
